Kite MCP + NSE MCP.

All order tools disabled via disabledTools in mcp_config.json.

Read access. Zero trading permissions.

That read-only split is a good starting point. I would also enforce it at the broker or API scope, so disabledTools is defense-in-depth rather than the only barrier. A routing bug should not be able to turn portfolio visibility into order authority.
M6 with 32GB+ is blessing for Content creator & AI explorer ( still not enough for bigger Models)
